h1: Interior design and furniture from Europe for clients in the USA

blocks.text: Interior design and furniture from Europe for clients in the USA

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN is an interior design studio with its own furniture production in Bratislava, Slovakia. For clients in the USA, we create design projects remotely, make cabinet furniture at our own facility, and supply premium upholstered furniture from Europe — with delivery to the USA and coordination of on-site installation.
We work with apartments, penthouses, private houses, and villas, as well as commercial spaces — boutiques, showrooms, and offices. Our projects include apartments in New York and Los Angeles.

blocks.text: What we do for clients in the USA

items: Remote design project — layout, concept, 3D visualization, and the selection of materials and lighting.
Technical documentation — drawings for furniture production and for local contractors.
Custom cabinet furniture — kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, and furniture for bedrooms, entrance halls, and home offices. Made at our own facility in Bratislava.
Premium upholstered furniture — sofas, armchairs, and beds from Europe, selected for your project: models, fabrics, and finishes.
Delivery to the USA — packing, international shipping, and delivery to your property.
Installation coordination — installation drawings, instructions, and scheduling of the on-site installation.

parts.html: We deliver projects in New York, Los Angeles, Miami, and other US cities.

items: Online consultation. We discuss your project by video call or messenger. You send us a floor plan, photos, and your wishes. The consultation is free.
Design project. Layout, concept, 3D visualizations, and documentation — everything is agreed remotely, and we make revisions based on your comments.

Furniture specification. We design the cabinet furniture from the drawings and select models, fabrics, and finishes for the upholstered pieces. Before production, we confirm the dimensions using on-site measurements.
Production. We make the cabinet furniture in Bratislava and check its quality before shipping.
Delivery. We pack the furniture and ship it from Europe to your property in the USA.
Installation. We coordinate the on-site installation based on our installation drawings.

parts.html: Developing the design takes 1–2 months; furniture production and delivery take 4–5 months after the design is approved.

parts.html: Design projects follow our studio packages, priced per m², from “Express” to “Premium+”. We calculate the cost of furniture and delivery to the USA based on the project and the specification. The first consultation is free.

items.q: Can I get a design project without traveling to Europe?
items.a: Yes. Every stage happens online: consultations, approval of the concept and 3D visualizations, and revisions. You receive the visualizations and drawings electronically.
A floor plan and photos are enough for the design project. Before furniture production, we confirm the dimensions using on-site measurements taken by your contractor according to our instructions.

items.q: What furniture do you ship from Europe?
items.a: We make cabinet furniture — kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, bedroom and home office furniture — at our own facility in Bratislava. Premium upholstered furniture — sofas, armchairs, and beds — we supply from Europe, selecting models, fabrics, and finishes for your project.

items.q: How long do the design and delivery take?
items.a: Developing the design takes 1–2 months. Furniture production and delivery to the USA take 4–5 months after the design is approved.

items.q: Who installs the furniture in the USA?
items.a: We coordinate the on-site installation: we prepare installation drawings and instructions and agree on the schedule with the local installation crew.

items.q: Which US cities do you work in?
items.a: New York, Los Angeles, Miami, and other US cities. You can message or call us on WhatsApp or Telegram at +421 918 17 77 85.

blocks.title: Request a free consultation
blocks.text: Tell us where the property is and what you need — we will reply within one business day.
